entities.summary: The Nordic Catholic Church, formerly known as the Lutheran Free Synod of Norway, is an Old Catholic church body of high church Lutheran patrimony, that is based in Norway. The church is a member of the Union of Scranton. Nordic Catholic Church is a Christian denomination in Europe, established in 1999. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
